per_question.question: In which seasons did the drivers' champion win fewer than half of the races held that year?
per_question.predicted_sql:
select s.year
from season_driver_standing s
join season_driver sd on sd.driver_id = s.driver_id and sd.year = s.year
join (select year, count(*) as race_count from race group by year) r on r.year = s.year
where s.championship_won
  and sd.total_race_wins < r.race_count / 2.0
order by s.year
per_question.gold_sql: select s.year from season_driver_standing s where s.position_number = 1 and ( select count(*) from race_result rr join race r on r.id = rr.race_id where r.year = s.year and rr.driver_id = s.driver_id and rr.position_number = 1 ) * 2 < (select count(*) from race r2 where r2.year = s.year) order by s.year
